inventory_method: Read-only SQLite connection; no database mutations. Contact sheet visually inspected.

scope.all_asanas: 71 reference-sheet cards are the real current pose catalog. The 2 verification cards are editor checks and should remain untouched unless separately requested.

notes: 71 imported poses retain separate variants from the first user sheet. Keep card ids, names, aliases and import keys while replacing current catalog images.
34 current names explicitly say «уточнить»; do not silently promote these to confirmed canonical names.
Names alone are not a sufficient visual mapping: some source sketches differ in arm positions, spine curves and perspective.
Existing practice snapshot asset references are immutable and must not be rewritten by catalog redraw.
Pose families and visual descriptions are visual interpretations for routing redraw work, not confirmed teaching labels.
